card.name: Small words in regulatory definitions
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as an, to, which, any, has or meet inside formal definitions and regulatory statements, just before a legal or agency term. Often follows 'similar to' or 'subject to'.

modes.description: The word an in the Biosimilar definition, right before FDA-approved.

modes.label: Linking word in legal definitions
modes.description: Words like which, any, to or meet that continue a rule or definition sentence.
modes.example: physical or mental impairment<< which>> substantially limits one or more major life activities
